question: What contrasting results are associated with the tail and other parts of the tortoise?
premises: Placement in the tail certainly brings death.
Other placements bring success in all purposes.
inference: The tail is an inauspicious location unlike the other parts.
uncertainties: The verse states both death and all-purpose successes; the latter may refer to remaining parts not named here.
plain_english: In the tail there is certainly death, but in the others there are successes in all purposes.
